scenes.title: What if recursion could sing?
scenes.text: What if a recursive function... could sing?

scenes.title: One call. A whole tree.
scenes.text: Meet Seedsong. One recursive call grows a whole tree... and the call tree itself becomes the music.

scenes.title: Call = note · Leaf = bell · Return = resolve
scenes.text: Every call is a note. Every leaf, the base case, rings a bell. And every return resolves the phrase.

scenes.title: The live call stack, drawn on the tree
scenes.text: That glowing path is the live call stack, from the trunk to the branch that's playing right now.

scenes.title: Every branch is a song of its own
scenes.text: And here's the twist. Every branch is a call of the same function... so every branch is a song of its own. Step inside one, and it grows into a smaller version of the whole.

scenes.title: See every frame, live
scenes.text: Open the lens to see every frame, and the exact line of code that's running.

scenes.title: Depth-first wanders. Breadth-first blooms.
scenes.text: Depth-first, the melody wanders. Breadth-first, it blooms, level by level.

scenes.title: Five moods. One tap.
scenes.text: Five moods change the scale, the instruments and the light, with one tap.

scenes.title: Shape the seed. Grow a grammar.
scenes.text: Shape the seed... or grow a fern from a grammar.

scenes.title: Breathe. Drift. Zen.
scenes.text: Then breathe, drift... and let zen mode take the controls away.

scenes.title: Keep it: WAV · MP3 · MIDI
scenes.text: Keep your song as WAV, MP3 or MIDI, and share a link that regrows it.
